touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Kinmel Bay qualifies as a local detour through Tir Prince Funland Amusement Park and Horton's Nose Nature Reserve. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Kinmel Bay: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Kinmel Bay offers Knightly's Fun Park, Tir Prince Funland Amusement Park, Horton's Nose Nature Reserve within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Knightly's Fun Park
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Knightly's Fun Park and Tir Prince Funland Amusement Park, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
